verdict.rationale: Google's docs describe search (matching on username), drag-to-reorder, and editing a code's username, which covers part of organizing many tokens. There is no evidence of folders, groups, or service icons, and manual reordering is a different control from grouping. Missing for 10: folders/groups, service icons, search beyond username matching, and independent hands-on corroboration of managing dozens of tokens.

support.subject: As a power user, I can keep dozens of tokens organized — search, folders or groups, and service icons — so the right code is always two taps away

citations.quote: To search through your Google Authenticator codes, enter any text matching the username to find the code.
To organize your Authenticator codes, touch and hold any code, then drag to reorder to a desired location.
You can update the username for the code or change the associated Google Account where that code is saved.
